caption: T598 or GT DD Pro? Both hold 5 Nm, so torque doesn't decide it. The T598 is about $600 and runs on PS5 and PC only. The GT DD Pro is about $700, also runs on Xbox with a licensed rim, takes the Boost Kit to 8 Nm, and its base is smaller: 140 x 230 mm against 200 x 290. Prices are our estimates. We earn from qualifying purchases. #ps5 #simracing
title: Thrustmaster T598 or Fanatec GT DD Pro for a PS5? Both are 5 Nm
